annotations.text:
FEW THINGS, BEAUTIFULLY

Pushed further than the last pass. The serif is now the largest thing on every screen it appears on — 76px on the hero fixture, 88px on the refund — and it appears about four times, so those moments carry the whole impression.

Dark surfaces are lit from one corner rather than filled flat, every lifted card carries two shadows, and a brass hairline fades out instead of stopping. Every screen is live.

THE CORE LOOP

On screen 1, tap either of the games under "Also tonight" — it takes the hero slot and the whole card rebuilds around it.

Then screen 3: "I can't make it" → "Offer my place". That interaction is the entire competitive argument against CeleBreak's forfeited credits, and it is now the most cinematic thing in the app on purpose.

WHY THESE THREE

Neither CeleBreak nor Stranger Soccer has any of it. The member card makes your standing portable between cities, the season makes next Thursday matter, and hosting turns the organisers they compete with into supply.

The member card is the one screen built to be screenshotted.

WHAT MAKES IT EXPENSIVE

Not ornament — scale and scarcity. One serif used four times a screen at a size nothing else comes near. One action per screen, 60px, pill. One dark surface, spent on exactly three moments.

Gilt only ever sits on dark. On bone it would read as costume jewellery.
